source.title: Dueling Network Architectures for Deep Reinforcement Learning
source.venue: Proceedings of the 33rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 48:1995-2003 (Best Paper); preprint arXiv:1511.06581

confidence_rationale: This is the closest available engineering precedent for SD-082(i), and the match is close enough to be structural rather than analogical. The dueling architecture computes a per-action head output and then subtracts the mean of that head across the action set -- 'Q(s,a) = V(s) + (A(s,a) - (1/|A|) sum_{a'} A(s,a'))' -- for two stated reasons that map one-to-one onto SD-082's two problems. First, IDENTIFIABILITY: the naive sum is 'unidentifiable in the sense that given Q we cannot recover V and A uniquely', because a constant can be added to one stream and subtracted from the other with no change in output. That is precisely the SD-082 pathology in reverse -- a shared additive component across the candidate set that the output cannot distinguish from zero, so gradient never resolves it. Second, OPTIMISATION STABILITY: the mean form is preferred over the max form because 'the advantages only need to change as fast as the mean, instead of having to compensate any change to the optimal action's advantage'. So mean-subtraction across a candidate/action set is not a REE invention or a hack around SD-008; it is an established, empirically validated primitive whose adoption was justified by the same reasoning SD-082 gives. Confidence high on source quality (ICML 2016 Best Paper, large-scale empirical validation across the Atari suite, and the mean-aggregation choice is specifically credited in the paper's own ablation reasoning) and high on mapping fidelity for component (i). Held below 0.85 because the paper says nothing about component (ii) -- it has no bounded output and no saturation problem -- and because dueling's shared component is an unidentifiable degree of freedom in the OUTPUT parameterisation, whereas SD-082's is a dominant structure in the INPUT.
failure_signatures: The dueling mean-subtraction is applied to the head's OUTPUT (the advantage stream), whereas SD-082(i) applies it to the head's INPUT (the candidate world summaries, before rule_bias_head). These are not equivalent. Subtracting the input mean is a linear reparameterisation only for the linear part of the head; the SD-033a head is a nonlinear MLP, so centering the input changes which region of the nonlinearity each candidate lands in -- a change dueling's argument does not cover and cannot underwrite. If the head's first-layer nonlinearity is where the differentiation is actually being lost, input-centering may shift rather than solve the problem.

Dueling networks subtract the mean to fix an identifiability problem that exists REGARDLESS of the input geometry -- it is a property of the V + A parameterisation. SD-082's common mode is a contingent property of a specific broken encoder (SD-008). The dueling precedent therefore does NOT license SD-082 as a permanent architectural commitment; it licenses it as a read-out-stage mitigation. If SD-008 / SD-070 are ever repaired at the encoder, the dueling analogy gives no reason to keep the centering, and it should be re-ablated rather than inherited.

The paper's stability argument is about the relative rate at which advantages must change, in a value-based off-policy setting with a replay buffer and target network. SD-082's head trains under on-policy REINFORCE in a short P1 window (70 episodes was already shown insufficient at the clamp). Neither the stability claim nor the sample-efficiency gains transfer to that regime, so nothing here predicts that centering alone makes the head trainable in the budget available -- it predicts only that the shared-component degeneracy is removed.

mapping.source_claim_statement: A Q-network can be factored into a state-value stream and a state-dependent action-advantage stream, but the naive aggregation Q = V + A 'is unidentifiable in the sense that given Q we cannot recover V and A uniquely' -- adding a constant to V and subtracting it from A leaves Q unchanged. The paper's preferred fix subtracts the mean advantage across the action set, Q(s,a) = V(s) + (A(s,a) - (1/|A|) sum_{a'} A(s,a')), chosen over subtracting the max because 'it increases the stability of the optimization: with (9) the advantages only need to change as fast as the mean, instead of having to compensate any change to the optimal action's advantage'. The architecture yields better policy evaluation in the presence of many similar-valued actions and state-of-the-art results on the Atari 2600 suite.
mapping.ree_translation: SD-082(i) subtracts the per-tick mean candidate summary across the candidate set (K >= 2) before the LateralPFCAnalog bias head. Dueling networks establish that this exact operation -- centering a per-alternative quantity against the mean over the alternative set -- is a principled and empirically validated primitive in deep RL, adopted for reasons that are the same reasons SD-082 gives. The identifiability argument is the sharper mapping: a component shared additively across all alternatives is invisible in the output and therefore unresolvable by gradient, which is exactly why V3-EXQ-822's prop_delta was a structural 0.0 rather than a small number. The stability argument supplies a second, independent motive: removing the shared component means the trainable part no longer has to track a large common signal, which is the trainability half of SD-082's problem (head grad-norm 0.0 -> ~6.1). Notably, dueling also reports the benefit is largest 'in the presence of many similar-valued actions' -- the closest ML statement of REE's near-collinear candidate cone.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Two boundaries. (1) SITE: dueling subtracts the mean of the head's OUTPUT; SD-082 subtracts the mean of the head's INPUT. For a nonlinear head these differ -- input-centering relocates each candidate within the nonlinearity, an effect dueling's linear identifiability argument does not address. (2) NATURE OF THE SHARED COMPONENT: in dueling it is an unidentifiable gauge freedom in the parameterisation, present for any input; in SD-082 it is a contingent pathology of a specific under-differentiated encoder (SD-008). The precedent therefore supports centering as a read-out mitigation and does NOT support treating it as an encoder-independent architectural commitment. Additionally, dueling is value-based off-policy with replay and target networks, while SD-082's head trains under on-policy REINFORCE; the stability and sample-efficiency findings do not transfer to that optimisation regime.
mapping.source_context: Deep RL methods paper. Arcade Learning Environment, 57 Atari 2600 games, discrete action sets; DQN-family value-based agents with experience replay, target networks and (in the strongest configuration) prioritised replay. The specific evidence used here is the architectural derivation of the aggregation module plus its empirical superiority over both single-stream baselines and the max-aggregation variant.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality 0.90: ICML 2016 Best Paper, heavily replicated, and the mean-aggregation design choice is argued explicitly in the text rather than left as an implementation detail -- which is what makes it usable as evidence for a design_decision claim rather than merely as a citation. Mapping fidelity 0.82, the highest in this pull: the operation (subtract the set mean from a per-alternative quantity), the stated motivation (a shared component is unresolvable), and even the stated favourable regime (many similar-valued alternatives) all correspond directly to SD-082(i) and to the V3-EXQ-822 signature. The deduction is for the input-vs-output site difference, which is real and not merely pedantic for a nonlinear head. Transfer risk 0.35: this is engineering-to-engineering transfer within deep RL, so no species or modality leap, but the optimisation regimes differ (off-policy value-based with replay vs on-policy REINFORCE) and the causes of the shared component differ (gauge freedom vs broken encoder). Aggregate 0.80: this is the entry that most directly de-risks SD-082(i) as a design choice, while deliberately not being read as evidence about SD-082(ii) or about the head's trainability under REE's actual training budget.
